ModMetaData.name: Combat Crash Probe
ModMetaData.author: Nanaloveyuki
ModMetaData.description: Temporary diagnostics for battle-related stack overflows in RimWorld 1.7. Records rescue, carrying, death and job transitions, with early stack snapshots and Harmony patch ownership when nesting grows. Does not suppress exceptions or change jobs, damage or rescue rules. Remove after collecting the crash evidence.
